Oliver: Quick sync — Orion Finance wants streaming + function/tool calls and strict structured JSON output for transaction enrichment. They also sent a security questionnaire. Can we pull together answers and any blockers?
Emma (SalesEng): Got it. Main asks: 1) websocket/SSE streaming for live scoring 2) ability to call external tools (sanitized lookups) 3) enforce JSON schema on outputs 4) data residency + KMS.
Raj (Solutions): For streaming we recommend our SSE endpoint with client-side reconnect. Example minimal snippet:```js
const ev = new EventSource('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=gpt-redwood-1');
ev.onmessage = e => console.log(JSON.parse(e.data));
// for toolcalls use the streaming function-call events protocol we documented
```
Emma (SalesEng): Also sent: "how to handle partial responses for structured validators?"
Raj (Solutions): We can emit incremental structured chunks keyed with `__chunk_id` so client-side validator can assemble then validate. Example tokenized fragment:```json
{"__chunk_id":1, "type":"partial", "payload":"{\"merchant\": \"Acme\""}
```
Leila (Security): Questionnaire Q: can you confirm support for customer-managed KMS & no-token-logging?
Emma (SalesEng): They want: Bring-your-own-kms, audit logs retained for 12 months, and an on-prem option for the dedicated instance.
Leila (Security): We support customer-managed KMS in Private and Dedicated. Hosted API: we offer envelope encryption integration with customer KMS for enterprise plans. No-token-logging option: we have a path (redact & not persist) under an enterprise contract, but ops needs approval for retention exceptions.
Oliver: Pricing question — they asked for a rough monthly estimate for a 100 qps streaming baseline with 2M tokens/day and 50k toolcall invocations. Any ballpark?
Raj (Solutions): Ballpark for Dedicated reservation: GPU pool + network + support. Rough calc: token compute ~ $X per million tokens (internal estimate), with 100 qps steady you'd be ~2.6B tokens/month? Wait re-check. If 2M tokens/day -> ~60M tokens/month. Toolcalls are cheap per-invocation. I'd quote: estimated usage tier for 60M tokens + tooling = reserved plan ~$12k-$18k/mo plus one-time onboarding. I'll flag for finance to firm number.
Emma (SalesEng): I'll mark as tentative and ask finance.
deploy-bot: deployment-checklist created: sales/integrations/1767123456-orion-integration-checklist.md
Oliver: Blockers from their side: corporate proxy requiring client certs, and SAML SSO for developer console access. They also requested on-prem installer checklist.
Raj (Solutions): For proxy with mTLS we can support client certs on Private deployments; hosted needs a reverse-proxy in their network to terminate mTLS and forward. SAML SSO: supported via SAML 2.0 for Console and can federate to their IdP.
Leila (Security): Add to questionnaire answers: SOC2 status, network segmentation guidance, data-at-rest encryption, HSM/KMS options, and details on deletion/retention policies. I'll draft answers.
Emma (SalesEng): Is there any runtime constraint with toolcalls + streaming + structured JSON? e.g., memory/KV cache usage or tokenization quirks?
Raj (Solutions): Toolcalls plus streaming increases latency slightly due to sync with tool endpoints. Recommend async tool patterns where possible and fallbacks. For structured JSON, use our `schema_enforce` param in call - it returns a `validation_result` field when streaming completes. For very large outputs chunking + prefix caching avoids re-generation.
Oliver: Action items: Emma -> finance pricing ask; Raj -> sample SSE + toolcall quickstart and a one-page runbook; Leila -> security questionnaire draft; Oliver -> send proposed engagement timeline to Orion.
Emma (SalesEng): Timeline: 2-week dev POC, 2-week integration, then Dedicated procurement (4-6 weeks).
Raj (Solutions): I'll attach a small demo repo after this thread. In the meantime, here's a helpful command for local sim of streaming toolcall (curl + netcat):```bash
# simulate SSE stream
echo -e 'data: {"type":"event","payload":"{\"result\\\":\"ok\\\"}"}\n\n' | nc -l 4100
# then curl to localhost:4100 to see chunks
```
Leila (Security): I'll push the questionnaire answers by EOD tomorrow. Include the encryption appendix and our SLA language.
Oliver: Thanks everyone. I'll loop in finance and schedule a short call with Orion to cover proxy and SSO details. :thumbsup:
Emma (SalesEng): tagging @finance once price estimate is ready. :raised_hands:
Raj (Solutions): demo repo link (will post here)
Oliver: closing notes: customer wants structured outputs validated on their side — we'll provide the `schema_enforce` flag sample and a small JSON schema example in the runbook.
